description: This file defines SCIM v2 API endpoints for LiteLLM Proxy, handling user and group (team) management operations such as create, retrieve, update, delete, and patch according to the SCIM v2 protocol. It includes functions for extracting data, error handling, and interfacing with the database to manage user and team entities, including complex relationship and membership updates.

classes.name: UserProvisionerHelpers
classes.description: Helper methods for user provisioning, including handling existing users by email and creating users if not present.

classes.name: GroupMemberExtractionResult
classes.description: Data structure for storing results of extracting group members, including existing member IDs, newly created users, and all member IDs.

methods.name: Optional[SCIMUser] handle_existing_user_by_email( prisma_client, new_user_request: NewUserRequest )
methods.description: Checks if a user with given email exists and updates their information if found, returning the updated SCIMUser.

methods.name: _get_prisma_client_or_raise_exception()
methods.description: Retrieves Prisma database client, raises HTTPException if not connected.

methods.name: _check_user_exists(user_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a user exists by user ID, raises 404 if not.

methods.name: _check_team_exists(team_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if a team exists by team ID, raises 404 if not.

methods.name: ScimUserData _extract_scim_user_data(user: SCIMUser)
methods.description: Extracts relevant user data from a SCIMUser object for internal processing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_scim_metadata( given_name: Optional[str], family_name: Optional[str], active: Optional[bool] = None )
methods.description: Constructs metadata dictionary containing SCIM-specific data.

methods.name: GroupMemberExtractionResult _extract_group_member_ids(group: SCIMGroup)
methods.description: Extracts member IDs from a SCIMGroup, creating users if they do not exist.

methods.name: List[SCIMMember] _get_team_members_display(member_ids: List[str])
methods.description: Retrieves display names for a list of user IDs.

methods.name: None _handle_team_membership_changes( user_id: str, existing_teams: List[str], new_teams: List[str] )
methods.description: Adjusts team membership for a user based on changed team list.

methods.name: Optional[NewUserResponse] _create_user_if_not_exists( user_id: str, created_via: str = "scim_group" )
methods.description: Creates a user if they do not already exist, used primarily during group Sync operations.

methods.name: List[str] _get_team_member_user_ids_from_team(team: LiteLLM_TeamTable)
methods.description: Gathers user IDs of team members from a team record.

methods.name: set_scim_content_type(response: Response)
methods.description: Sets HTTP response Content-Type to application/scim+json.

methods.name: get_service_provider_config(request: Request)
methods.description: Returns the SCIM Service Provider Configuration.

methods.name: get_users( startIndex: int = Query(1, ge=1), count: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100), filter: Optional[str] = Query(None), )
methods.description: Lists users with optional filtering & pagination, returning SCIM formatted data.

methods.name: get_user( user_id: str = Path(..., title="User ID"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user by ID in SCIM format.

methods.name: create_user( user: SCIMUser = Body(...), )
methods.description: Creates a new user, checking for duplicates by userName and updating existing users if necessary.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: str = Path(..., title="User ID"), user: SCIMUser = Body(...), )
methods.description: Performs full replacement update of an existing user with provided data.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: str = Path(..., title="User ID"), )
methods.description: Deletes a user and removes them from all associated teams.

methods.name: get_groups( startIndex: int = Query(1, ge=1), count: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100), filter: Optional[str] = Query(None), )
methods.description: Lists groups with pagination & filtering support, returning SCIM group representations.

methods.name: get_group( group_id: str = Path(..., title="Group ID"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group by ID in SCIM format.

methods.name: create_group( group: SCIMGroup = Body(...), )
methods.description: Creates a new group, with creation of users if they don't already exist.

methods.name: update_group( group_id: str = Path(..., title="Group ID"), group: SCIMGroup = Body(...), )
methods.description: Replaces an existing group, including its members, with new data.

methods.name: delete_group( group_id: str = Path(..., title="Group ID"), )
methods.description: Deletes a group and removes related user memberships.

methods.name: patch_user( user_id: str = Path(..., title="User ID"), patch_ops: SCIMPatchOp = Body(...), )
methods.description: Applies partial updates to a user using SCIM patch operations.

methods.name: patch_group( group_id: str = Path(..., title="Group ID"), patch_ops: SCIMPatchOp = Body(...), )
methods.description: Applies partial updates to a group using SCIM patch operations, including membership changes.
